verdict.rationale: Scheduling is a fair question for a workflow automation tool, but the evidence pack never documents a schedule or cron trigger, and never mentions timezone settings. It only says flows have a trigger and actions. The changelog prompt "summarise my unread emails every morning" shows agent drafting from plain language, not a documented recurring cron schedule with timezone control.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run workflows on cron-style schedules with timezone control
